detailed_descriptions.en: YOUR GRANDMA ROSE HAS WILLED YOU HER COLLECTION OF ROCKS Rock and Found is a cozy first-person game about identifying stones and putting them where they belong. Lift a rock out of the pile, work out what it actually is, and carry it to the correct shelf. REAL MINERALOGY, GENTLE DEDUCTION Learn how to identify hundreds of rocks using tools real mineralogists use: Determine the Mohs hardness using your fingernails, steel, glass, and quartz Find the streak color by rubbing the rock against a porcelain plate Determine reactivity by dropping acid on rocks Use a UV lamp to see which rocks light up and more! LEARN FROM GRANDMA'S JOURNAL AND NOTES As you uncover more stones and clean up more of the collection, discover entries and notes that teach you how to identify more rocks, and learn more about the collection. THE COLLECTION KEEPS GOING Past the lobby, a great hall, a glowing cave, a locked vault and more are waiting to be sorted. Unlock unique tools and sort real, themed rocks! WHAT YOU'LL FIND IN THE COLLECTION Thousands of rocks, minerals, and fossils to sort through 10+ hours of relaxing sorting Easy to understand controls No AI-generated content. Everything was either made by hand or comes from free, openly licensed sources online EVERY ROCK HAS A HOME Content note: the story involves bereavement and the death of a family member, including a death in childbirth.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
YOUR GRANDMA ROSE HAS WILLED YOU HER COLLECTION OF ROCKS
Rock and Found is a cozy first-person game about identifying stones and putting them where they belong. Lift a rock out of the pile, work out what it actually is, and carry it to the correct shelf.



REAL MINERALOGY, GENTLE DEDUCTION
Learn how to identify hundreds of rocks using tools real mineralogists use:


  • Determine the Mohs hardness using your fingernails, steel, glass, and quartz
  • Find the streak color by rubbing the rock against a porcelain plate
  • Determine reactivity by dropping acid on rocks
  • Use a UV lamp to see which rocks light up
  • and more!


LEARN FROM GRANDMA'S JOURNAL AND NOTES

As you uncover more stones and clean up more of the collection, discover entries and notes that teach you how to identify more rocks, and learn more about the collection.

THE COLLECTION KEEPS GOING
Past the lobby, a great hall, a glowing cave, a locked vault and more are waiting to be sorted. Unlock unique tools and sort real, themed rocks!

WHAT YOU'LL FIND IN THE COLLECTION
  • Thousands of rocks, minerals, and fossils to sort through
  • 10+ hours of relaxing sorting
  • Easy to understand controls
  • No AI-generated content. Everything was either made by hand or comes from free, openly licensed sources online

EVERY ROCK HAS A HOME


Content note: the story involves bereavement and the death of a family member, including a death in childbirth.
